entities.name: Akiyama Yoshifuru
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Akiyama Yoshifuru  was a general in the Imperial Japanese Army, and was considered the father of modern Japanese cavalry. He was the older brother of Vice Admiral Akiyama Saneyuki.
